plan: I will implement the arc-length path follower as specified. First, I add a static helper `_poly_point` to `town_view.gd` to calculate positions on a polyline. Next, I modify `_update_walkers` and `_update_background` to initialize `poly` and `s` for new walkers. When a goal changes, I build the `poly` array (current pos + path points) and reset `s` to 0.0. I replace the waypoint-chasing loop with logic that advances `s` by the movement budget, clamps it to the polyline length, updates `pos` using `_poly_point`, and updates `dir` based on the segment direction. I also ensure `v["path"]` is kept in sync by popping waypoints whose arc position is passed, satisfying the requirement that it must be empty on arrival. Finally, I reset `poly` and `s` when walkers are relocated silently or paths are cleared. This ensures `feet == P(s)` and `s` is monotonic, fixing the `suite.arc_follow` failure. The zebra overlap failures are expected to persist as avoidance is not part of this job.
